subject: Static, hybrid or powered: what changes the recommendation?
preheader: Compare the Forté range in person and sharpen the questions you take into every mattress trial.
intro: The difficult part of mattress selection is not knowing the categories. It is deciding what matters enough to move from one support surface to another for a particular client.
On 21 October, Craig Gorman from Forté Healthcare will compare static, hybrid and powered mattresses in Brighton East and explore the clinical reasoning behind the choice.
sectionTitle: See what changes between the surfaces
body: This is a practical two-hour session for occupational therapists working across community, aged care and acute settings. Craig will cover pressure-care fundamentals, pressure-injury prevention, support-surface technologies and their application in everyday practice, with time for discussion and Q&A.

Forté is the clinical mattress range we are most excited to work with and stand behind. The session gives you direct access to their product and pressure-care expertise, with the range available to compare in person.

The learning can move directly into practice. Through Sleep Choice, OTs can arrange flexible seven-night home trials across the Forté mattress range to assess comfort, positioning, transfers, usability and overall suitability before finalising a recommendation.
eventTitle: See the range. Ask the difficult questions.
detail: In-person OT session · Forté lists 2 CPD points
